readme_protocol.charge_protocol: CC 1.5 A to 4.2 V, then CV until charge current falls to 20 mA
readme_protocol.discharge_protocol: CC 2 A to 2.7 V for battery 5
readme_protocol.capacity_field: Discharge capacity in Ah for discharge to 2.7 V
readme_protocol.other_operation: EIS frequency sweep from 0.1 Hz to 5 kHz

source_evidence.interpretation: The B0005 protocol matches the README description attached to the Capacity field (2 A discharge to 2.7 V at room temperature), so capacities are conditionally comparable under the documented protocol. The README does not designate any particular observed discharge as a baseline/reference-performance test or say that the first observed Capacity measurement is the cell-specific beginning-of-life capacity.
source_evidence.eol_protocol_discrepancy: README1.txt says experiments stopped at 1.4 Ah, but the raw B0005 file contains 44 discharge measurements below 1.4 Ah. The first below-threshold observation is source cycle index 449 at 1.3967008233 Ah; the final recorded capacity is 1.3250793286 Ah. Available local records do not explain why data continue below the stated EOL criterion; do not infer the reason.

trace_diagnostics_not_capacity_substitut.interpretation: Sparse sampled traces corroborate operation context only; they are not used to replace the source Capacity field or establish a reference.

capacity_ratio_vs_soh.rated_capacity_ratio_definition: 100 * measured discharge capacity (Ah) / documented rated capacity (2.0 Ah)
capacity_ratio_vs_soh.rated_capacity_ratio_interpretation: A measured-capacity-to-rated-capacity ratio (nominal-capacity comparison), not SOH relative to a measured cell-specific reference. The denominator is rated capacity, not a baseline measurement from B0005.
capacity_ratio_vs_soh.measured_reference_soh_definition: 100 * measured discharge capacity (Ah) / a source-validated B0005 reference capacity (Ah) obtained using a documented comparable reference-performance test.
capacity_ratio_vs_soh.measured_reference_soh_status: blocked; no such B0005 reference test/measurement is identified in the available records

prediction_time_feature_contract.prediction_horizon_assumption: Predict the next discharge capacity/SOH before that target discharge begins; features must be known by this cutoff.
potential_features_if_available_before_c: elapsed time derived only from prior timestamps
ambient temperature known before the target cycle
summary features from completed earlier charge/discharge traces (voltage, current, cell temperature, duration)
features from a completed earlier EIS operation, when EIS is explicitly part of the intended deployment protocol
exclude_as_target_leakage: target-cycle discharge trace or any statistic requiring samples after prediction time
the target-defining reference capacity/denominator as a model input unless a separately validated deployment contract proves it is independently available and not label-derived
prediction_time_feature_contract.split_requirement: Use chronological splits for next-cycle prediction; never randomly split cycles from the same battery across train and evaluation. B0005 alone cannot establish generalization to unseen batteries.

decision.why: Protocol compatibility makes the Capacity observations useful for within-protocol degradation analysis, but available documentation only supplies rated-capacity and EOL criteria; it does not identify a B0005 measured reference-performance test or validate any observed cycle as the reference. The raw cycle sequence alone cannot establish that missing experimental designation. Also, the raw data continue below the README's stated 1.4 Ah stopping criterion, and the available files do not explain this discrepancy.
exact_missing_evidence: Authoritative B0005 test-schedule/protocol record identifying a full-capacity reference-performance test and its cycle/time/location in the sequence.
The actual conditioning and measurement record for any nominated baseline: charge sequence, rest interval if any, ambient temperature, and confirmation of the complete 2 A CC discharge to 2.7 V.

Clarification whether the first recorded discharge is an initial characterization or already part of aging cycling, plus confirmation of the reported 2 Ah rated-capacity basis for this specific cell and its test conditions.

Explanation of why the raw sequence contains 44 discharge-capacity values below the README's stated 1.4 Ah EOL stopping criterion, including whether the stopping rule was approximate, changed, or applied differently.
decision.next_evidence_based_option: Request the B0005 cell-specific Arbin/NASA experiment schedule and reference-performance-test designation/records from the NASA PCoE dataset curator. Until received, keep SOH training blocked; if a clearly distinct research target is useful, define and name it as capacity relative to rated 2.0 Ah (not SOH), preserve protocol metadata, and validate that estimand separately.

provenance.cycle_record_source: Original cycle array in B0005.mat; MATLAB source-cycle index is 1-based and operation labels are retained.
provenance.reconciliation: All 168 raw discharge capacity values and cycle indices match the corresponding B0005 entries in data/processed/nasa_soh_reference_evidence_audit.json.
provenance.source_document_scope: README1.txt documents the group protocol and data structure; the available local files do not identify a cell-specific reference-performance operation.
